findings.claim: Original editor exporter 004030C0 multiplies editable road horizontal coordinates by five when writing runtime/world-space road mesh samples.
findings.limitations: Does not alone establish exact raster cell occupancy.

findings.claim: Road grade lateral widths 5 and 2 in original 00421DF0 are editor-grid-cell spans; scaling by 5 gives nominal 25-world-unit preparatory and 10-world-unit late material widths, correcting the earlier v25 world-unit labels.
findings.limitations: Prequantization widths, not exact occupied-cell footprints; related v25 evidence remains unmerged and historical.

findings.claim: Original 004235A4 selects truncation toward zero for FISTP and selected 00421DF0 conversion checks signed remainder of trunc(x*10) modulo ten greater than four to optionally add one.
findings.limitations: Exact original full road export FPU evaluation and tie behavior were not reproduced end-to-end.

findings.claim: For 220 bounded FP32 cases, original FPU opcode paths stepped in the read-only Ghidra 12.1.4 emulator disagreed with instruction-equivalent hardware x87 on 37 adjusted float outputs, despite zero emulator execution errors.

evidence.ref: private local v26 original FPU Ghidra and hardware differential checkpoint

findings.limitations: Hardware x87 on x86-64 does not execute original 32-bit PE; the observed emulator issue is setup-specific, not a universal claim.

findings.claim: Read-only RSEG-based proxy classified 89595 original road sections and examined 286683 reconstructed late-pass class-2 cell probes; 280598 exact and 3403 known aliases matched road-kind material, while 2682 differed.
findings.limitations: Shipped RSEG edges are runtime export output, not editable ROAD input; scan was bounded diagnostic and cell probes nonindependent.

findings.claim: Original I76EDIT.EXE 00409210 instructions emulated against 240 selected retail RSEG-derived integer samples returned all independent expected class labels with zero errors.
findings.limitations: Classifier-only original execution; raster and x87 path not original-code emulated end-to-end.
